abilities.effect: The triggering creature or object falls in and takes falling damage (10 bludgeoning damage) and is targeted by a spike's Strike. A falling creature can attempt to Grab an Edge with a DC 20 Reflex save (this becomes a DC 22 Reflex save if rushing waters are pouring into the pit).
abilities.name: Pitfall
abilities.trigger: A creature or other large weight (such as the rushing waters of the previous trap) moves onto the gravel-covered hide

hazard.description: A piece of hide covered with a layer of dirt and gravel is suspended over a 20-foot pit filled with spikes.
hazard.disable: DC 18 Thievery (trained) to manually trigger the trap without falling in, or DC 25 Thievery (trained) to secure the hide so the trap doesn't activate
hazard.name: Spiky Pit Trap
hazard.reset: Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the hide that covers it must be reset manually (a 10-minute activity) for the trap to become hidden again.

traits.name: Uncommon
traits.text: Something of uncommon rarity requires special training or comes from a particular culture or part of the world. Some character choices give access to uncommon options, and the GM can choose to allow access for anyone. Less is known about uncommon creatures than common creatures. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creature is increased by 2.

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
